title: Node RPC fence (frame 0)
description: The first frame of every invocation, length-prefixed and read alone. The receiver checks it against what it is and what it serves before the second frame is read, allocated or parsed. It is core: the same two checks for every protocol. It carries nothing about the process birth: which birth of a node a caller is talking to is the resolver's and the pool's knowledge (the incarnation, held locally and never sent); a restart's old connection dies with its process and a replacement is a new node id.

target_node_id.description: The minted id of the node the caller resolved. A receiver whose own id differs answers STALE_TARGET and drops the connection: the caller reached a replacement at that path, or misrouted.

op.description: The operation code, a row of the op ledger (catalog.rs). The ledger owns the code's family, owner and the method names registered under it. An op this node does not serve answers UNSERVED_OP and keeps the connection.

node_id.description: A minted node id: 60 bits, 12 lowercase Crockford characters, never a path.name, never an EndpointId.
